text: idle-scholar 是一款面向 DSH 的碎片学习插件，可在工具调用等等待间隙提供英语、日语和中国法考学习卡。它通过系统提示和嵌入式 skill 引导 agent 在不打断主任务的前提下展示卡片，并注册抽卡、进度查询和课程切换工具。抽卡支持课程、牌组和卡片类型筛选，按已学习记录调整抽取并自动保存每日次数与连续学习天数。用户可添加 JSON 课程包、查看今日目标和牌组覆盖率，或更改默认课程。适合希望利用 agent 工作等待时间学习并跟踪进度的 DSH 用户；无需 API 密钥，进度保存在本机。

idle-scholar adds English, Japanese, and judicial exam flashcards to DSH waiting gaps. Its tools draw cards, track daily study progress, and switch courses. JSON course packs are extensible, and progress is stored locally. It suits users who want short study sessions while their agent works.
想趁 agent 调工具等待时顺手背一张英语卡。
有没有办法在 DSH 等待期间练日语词汇或语法？
我想用碎片时间复习中国法考各科知识点。
让 DSH 每次有较长等待时给我一道学习题。
我想查看今天学了多少、连续学了几天以及牌组覆盖情况。
能不能把默认学习课程从英语切换到法考？
Show me a short study flashcard while my agent is waiting on a tool call.
I want to review Japanese or English in small gaps during DSH work.
idle-scholar 的功能「抽取学习卡」：study_card 可按课程、牌组和卡片类型筛选，从英语、日语、法考等课程中抽取卡片，并返回题目、提示、答案和解析；抽取后记录学习进度。
idle-scholar 的功能「查看学习进度」：study_status 汇报今日学习数与目标、连续天数、累计抽取数、已看卡片覆盖率和可用课程，方便用户了解复习情况。
idle-scholar 的功能「切换默认课程」：study_switch 接收可用课程 id 并保存选择；之后不带课程参数的 study_card 会从新的默认课程抽卡。
idle-scholar 的功能「加载自定义课程包」：用户可配置 coursesDir，插件递归读取其中的 JSON 课程牌组，校验数据后与内置课程一起提供抽卡；无法加载的文件会记录为错误。
idle-scholar 使用本机状态文件保存课程选择和学习记录，默认位置为 $DSH_HOME/idle-scholar.json；可通过 stateFile 改路径。

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · idle-scholar：Idle-time micro-learning for DeepSeek Harness: turns the agent's waiting gaps
(tool calls, MCP connects, large file reads, subagent dispatches) into flash
cards — one card per waiting turn, never in the way.

Ships seed decks for **English**, **Japanese**, and the **eight subjects of the
Chinese National Judicial Examination** (法考: 刑法 · 民法 · 刑诉 · 民诉 · 行政法 ·
商经知 · 三国法 · 理论法). New subjects are plain JSON course packs — a
community deck is a PR that adds files.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · How it works：The plugin teaches the model two things and gives it the cards:

1. **A system-prompt section** — when a turn will keep the user waiting, show
   one study card at the very start of that turn, then continue the main task.
2. **An embedded skill** (`idle-scholar`) — the full workflow: card formats,
   course rotation, the "别学了" opt-out.

Three tools supply the content and track progress:

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · How it works：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `study_card` | Draw a card (optional `course` / `deck` / `type` filters). Seen-weighting: never-seen cards first, immediate repeats excluded. |
| `study_status` | Today's count vs the daily goal, streak, deck coverage, course catalog. |
| `study_switch` | Change the default course; persisted across sessions. |

Progress (per-card seen counts, daily totals, streak) is stored in
`$DSH_HOME/idle-scholar.json` — out of the repository.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Installation (DSH plugin)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/idle_scholar
```

Then reload the harness. On DeepSeek Harness ≥ 0.2.1-alpha.3 with hot reload
enabled, code updates to this plugin apply without a restart; a fresh install
still needs one. If your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` already has an
`idle-scholar` row, delete it first — duplicate registrations fail to boot.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Installation (DSH plugin)：> Recreating a profile with `dsh … --from-default-profile` **replaces** that
> profile, including its plugins — re-add the plugin afterwards.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Installation (standalone skill, any agent tool)：The skill is a portable [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) file:

```bash
cp -r skills/idle-scholar ~/.claude/skills/   # or ~/.agents/skills, ~/.codex/skills, ...
```

Without the plugin tools, the skill still works: the model generates cards in
real time following `skills/idle-scholar/references/course-topics.md`.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. Gates the prompt section (the only nagging surface); tools and skill stay mounted. |
| `defaultCourse` | `'en'` | Course `study_card` draws from when no filter is passed. |
| `dailyGoal` | `10` | Cards per day, used for progress reporting. |
| `promptSection` | `true` | Expose the system-prompt section. |
| `skill` | `true` | Register the embedded `idle-scholar` skill. |
| `coursesDir` | — | Extra directory of course packs, loaded in addition to the bundled decks. |
| `stateFile` | `$DSH_HOME/idle-scholar.json` | Progress file location. |

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Course pack format：A **deck** is one JSON file at `courses/<course>/<deck>.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "en-vocab",
  "course": "en",
  "name": "English core vocabulary",

Card types: `vocab` (word card), `quiz` (multiple choice, `answer` is an index
into `choices`), `concept` (knowledge point), `tip` (culture / practical
advice). All cards need a non-empty `explanation`.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Contributing a new subject：1. Create `courses/<course-id>/<deck-id>.json` following the format above
   (deck and card ids must be globally unique — `test/decks.test.js` enforces
   it).
2. Add the course and its decks to
   `skills/idle-scholar/references/course-topics.md` so skill-only
   deployments can generate on-topic cards.
3. Update the course table in `skill.js` (`npm run skill` regenerates
   `SKILL.md`; `npm run skill:check` verifies it).
4. `npm test` — the deck validator will catch malformed cards.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Development：```bash
npm test            # unit + fake-ctx + real cordis integration tests
npm run skill:check # SKILL.md is in sync with skill.js
```

Prerequisites: the integration tests import the DeepSeek Harness packages
(`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `dsh-tools`, `dsh-skill`, `dsh-system-prompt`) at
runtime. They are `peerDependencies` — link them from your harness checkout
or profile, and the tests skip with a clear reason if they cannot resolve.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Development：The versions this plugin develops against are pinned in `devDependencies`.
They are published to npm but **not under the `latest` tag** — npm's `latest`
for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is still the placeholder `0.0.1-rc.1`, while this
plugin targets **`0.2.2-rc.1`** (reached through the `next` dist-tag). Its
companion versions are `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `4.1.0` and
`@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `3.19.0`; pin all three together. Note that
`rc.1` has no dedicated `dsh-0-2-2-*` dist-tag, so the exact version strings
in `devDependencies` are the only source of truth.

@dsh-plugin/idle-scholar README · Development：Since `0.2.2-alpha.2` the tool registry no longer owns the model-facing tool
descriptions: assembling the system prompt asks the registry for its executor
and throws `TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE` when the composition has none. A real
deployment gets one from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`; a composition you build by
hand has to mount `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-native` after the registry,
which is what `test/integration.test.js` does.
